panels.description: A crumpled, grease-stained sheet shows a crude pencil pump-bracket sketch with fingerprints and no patent number. Keep it unobstructed.
Alex’s daughter studies the drawing while Alex stands beside her. Reserve upper-left for her balloon and lower-right for Alex’s reply.
The daughter beams at the drawing. Leave the upper third open for lettering.
Alex looks from the sketch down to Adrian’s old steel wristwatch on his left wrist, thumb covering the watch face. Leave upper-left open.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: And the one I'm most proud of. It helped a lot of people.

items.speaker: DAUGHTER
items.text: That looks like a lot of fun!
